author: The Infographics Show
description:
You finally find the perfect job online, spend hours applying, and then realize it never existed.

Why companies are posting fake job ads exposes the growing trend of “ghost jobs”, positions companies advertise even though they have no intention of hiring.
Some use them to collect resumes for the future, others to appear like they’re growing, and some even use interviews to extract ideas and free work from desperate candidates.

With studies suggesting up to 40% of companies post fake jobs, millions of applicants may be wasting their time chasing positions that were never real to begin with.

So why are companies doing it, and why does it keep getting worse?

0:28 - Why Companies Post Phantom Jobs
2:28 - The Interview Heist
4:08 - Companies Steal Free Work
5:32 - Fake Jobs to Look Successful
6:34 - Data Farming and Ghost Listings
7:20 - The Ghost Job Epidemic
8:44 - Why Job Seekers Keep Losing

Narrated by: Josh Risser
